02Authenticity
Every watch, every time

Inspected, genuine, and described as it is.

Authenticity is the whole point. A watch is only worth buying if it is what the listing says it is, so nothing goes up for sale until we are sure of it.

  1. 01

    Every watch is inspected

    Each watch is looked over closely before it is listed.

  2. 02

03About
What we stand for

Watches sold the way we would want to buy them.

Wexler Watches sells watches through eBay. Buying a watch you can't hold first takes trust, so we keep things plain: say exactly what the watch is, show it as it is, and look after it until it reaches you.

  • Honest descriptions

    Each listing says what the watch is and the condition it is in. Nothing glossed over.

  • Authenticity

    We only list watches we are satisfied are genuine.

  • Care in handling

    Every watch is handled and packed with care, from our hands to yours.

  • Service

    Questions are welcome before and after you buy, and they get a straight answer.
